# Just 7 Laundry Sheets (Just Seven)

> Fragrance-free laundry detergent sheets with seven ingredients, every one named: pullulan film, lauryl glucoside, decyl glucoside, sodium carbonate, plant glycerin, sodium citrate and water. Nothing from animals. 7% of every sale goes to animal sanctuaries and nonprofits. Pre-order now. Orders ship Jan 11th.

Prices: $19 one-time, $15 each with subscribe and save, $14 each on 3 or more. 30 sheets, up to 60 loads per pouch. 90-day keep-the-pouch promise.
